description:
Search Google Maps for businesses by text query, optionally centred on coordinates. Returns each place with its name, address, coordinates, category, rating, review count, opening hours, website and phone where Google publishes them, plus the place id you can pass to Google Maps Place Details.

upAPI operation `google-maps-search.post` (Maps). Costs 6 units of monthly quota per call.

language.description: Language for names and hours, as an ISO code (e.g. "en", "fr").
language.title: Language

latitude.description: Centre the search on this latitude (e.g. 45.4215). Pass with `longitude`. Omit to let Google infer the area from the query text.
latitude.title: Latitude

longitude.description: Centre the search on this longitude (e.g. -75.6972). Pass with `latitude`.
longitude.title: Longitude

maxResults.description: How many places to return, up to 100 (e.g. 40). Google serves 20 per page, so higher values cost proportionally more time.
maxResults.title: Maxresults

proxyUrl.description: Route the request through your own proxy (e.g. http://user:pass@host:port). Omit to use upAPI's pool.
proxyUrl.title: Proxyurl

query.description: What to search for, exactly as you would type it into Google Maps (e.g. "coffee shops in Ottawa" or "dentist near Shoreditch London").
query.title: Query

region.description: Two-letter country code biasing the results (e.g. "ca", "gb").
region.title: Region

zoom.description: Map zoom for the coordinate search, controlling the radius: 13 is roughly a city (the default), 16 a neighbourhood, 10 a metro area.
zoom.title: Zoom

name: google_maps_search_post
title: Google Maps Business Search
